_meta.what: Published values harvested from the anchor searches, in consumable form.
_meta.rule: A row is kept only when number, unit and locator share one line. Everything else is counted as unextracted, never dropped silently.
_meta.consumption_rule: Same three requirements as the literature collection: the dimension must match, the validity range must overlap the cell, and the record must carry a measurement and not a threshold sentence.
